notes.title: AlphaDemo Build 0.1.44 Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey gamers,

As mentioned, here is our first batch of bug fixes and adjustments for the Schwarzwald alpha demo.

Patch Notes:
[olist]
 Changing tip for doors to be more clear about how to open doors. Doors are click, hold and move forward/backward to hold which allows for you to quickly open doors. Additionally you can click and drag to open doors slowly which allows players to peek through the door first.
 Panic heartbeat now starts much later.
 Panic doesn't go up from just holding shift (run key). Instead it goes up specifically if you are moving while running. 
 Panic stages adjusted so that spooks happen less frequently.
 Autosave info screen added.
 Bug Fix - Kitchen save point now works properly.
 Bug Fix - Fixed toilet collider so that its easier to aim at things inside the toilet.
 Bug Fix - Various smaller audio improvements and fixes.
[/olist]

We will continue to watch playthroughs and keep an eye out for community feedback to actively improve the horror experience in Schwarzwald. There will be more adjustments coming based off the feedback we've already seen including a tutorial sequence.

As many of you know we have a small team who are work in their spare time after their day jobs so we appreciate your patience as we work to make Schwarzwald the best horror game it can be!

If you wish to give feedback or get info earlier, we recommend joining our discord channel!
https://discord.gg/v5sXwn3ZvC
-

Thanks for all your support!
